title: Treat monthly investments as stable salary allocation
body:
## Summary
- Adds `plans.investment_fixed` so salary settings now model: salary → mandatory expenses → insurance → fixed investments → surplus for wishes.
- Updates allocation math so wishlist/manual-plan budgets use only `availableToAllocate = salary - survival - reserve - fixedInvestment`.
- Refreshes dashboard/settings/scenario copy to make investments a stable salary allocation, separate from the investments tracking tab.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/1fac82730d634902914c0233c5726533
